photos.desc: Canadaspis perfecta gathering to mate and moult in the Walcott Quarry of the Burgess Shale (Phyllopod Bed, Layer -350)
Wiwaxia corrugata from the Burgess Shale. Juvenile specimen, preserved sublaterally; mouthparts are visible to anterior, with dark transverse trace underneath, interpreted as anterior margin of foot.
Wiwaxia corrugata, fossil. Registration no. P 30656.
Fossil specimen of Wiwaxia from the Burgess Shale on display at the Smithsonian in Washington, DC.
Specimen of Wiwaxia Corrugata on display in the Royal Ontario Museum, Toronto.
